message.content: IllidanStormrage suggested the concept of creating a flyer or some form of informational material that lists local businesses. This approach was aimed at promoting community involvement in the garden renovation project while also highlighting the importance of supporting local enterprises. The idea was to generate a sense of unity and collective effort, showcasing how backing these businesses could enhance the garden project and, in turn, benefit the local area as a whole. The proposed flyer would serve as a tool to disseminate information about the participating vendors, fostering a stronger connection between the community garden initiative and the local economy.
